title: Privacy Policy
intro: This is a stand-in. PartnerStandard Desk's hosted service at https://desk.partnerstandard.com shows its operator's own privacy policy, which its build adds from a private place. A server you run yourself shows none of these pages: it links to your own, set with `LEGAL_PRIVACY_URL` (deploy/.env.example).

sections.heading: 1. What this page is
blocks: The text of a privacy policy, as data: a title, the date it takes effect, and numbered sections.

sections.heading: 2. How a page is laid out
